detail.longDescription:
I posted about Parley the other day. Federated chat that's compatible with regular IRC clients. I'm running my own test instance now, which is linked up with the official server and the rest of the testers.

https://parley.mauve.haus/

If you want to try it out, hit me up and I'll make you an account. You can then create a token through the web under settings and use that as a password to connect via any IRC client you wish.

I freaking LOVE IT!

https://git.mills.io/prologic/parley

#selfhosted #selfhosting #IRC #fediverse
